'''Luntobetha''' was an [[Luntobetha's species|alien]]<ref name="TAVG" /> found on the [[planet]] [[Olega]].<ref name="RJ">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}}</ref>

==Biography==
Luntobetha was an [[I-Zellam's species|alien]]<ref name="TAVG" /> individual who had taken up residence and worked on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] as a clothing dyer and vendor<ref name="RJ" /> by [[132 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Luntobetha usually fully concealed her appearance, leading to a rather intimidating visage when observed by strangers, though [[Olega City]] locals knew she was anything but, being a hardworking and friendly clothing dyer.<ref name="TAVG" />

==Equipment==
Luntobetha outfitted herself in full-body [[clothing]]<ref name="RJ" /> and jacket covered in tight cinch straps, with an old [[Bando Gora]] mask repurposed to help her filter our caustic dye fumes via an attached [[atmo-scanner]] and [[filter rebalancer]]. She also concealed a money belt around her waist.<ref name="TAVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Luntobetha made their debut in the [[Revenge / Justice|second episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Leslye Headland]].<ref name="RJ" /> Their name was revealed within the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''<ref name="TAVG" /> which released in select countries on [[June 5]], [[2025]].<ref name="DK UK">{{DK|url=uk/book/9780241710425-star-wars-the-acolyte-visual-guide|text=Star Wars The Acolyte Visual Guide}}</ref> [[Martin Rezard]] worked on the prosthetics for Luntobetha.<ref name="RezardEmail">{{EmailCite|email=File:MartinRezard-AcolyteEmail.png|creator=Martin Rezard|date=2025-10-05}}</ref>
